question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Cost an arm and a leg
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Cost an arm and a leg"** means to be extremely expensive or to cost a lot of money. (बहुत महंगा होना)

 
 
• **Example: **The new iPhone** costs an arm and a leg.**
 
 
 
• **"Be extremely expensive"** means something that requires a lot of money to purchase or obtain. (बहुत महंगा)
 
 
• **Example: **Buying a house in the city can **be extremely expensive.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To lose a friend **(एक दोस्त को खोना): To end a friendship or to no longer have a friend.

 
 
• **Example:** She was devastated to lose a friend after their argument.
 
 
 
• **Occurring unexpectedly **(अचानक घटित होना): Happening without warning or unplanned.
 
 
• **Example: **The rainstorm occurred unexpectedly during our picnic.
 
 
 
• **To be a good dancer** (एक अच्छा नर्तक होना): To have the ability to dance well.
 
 
• **Example:** She is known to be a good dancer and often wins competitions.
